  SELECT investor_id, COUNT(holding_id) AS num_holdings

cashflow_per_investor AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow

  GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_per_investor AS (
  SELECT investor_id, risk_score

LEFT JOIN cashflow_per_investor c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id

combined AS (
  SELECT
    cf.investor_id,
    cf.net_cash_flow,
    rb.total_rebalance_amount,
    sec.total_sector_investment,
    sc.total_scenario_allocation_shift
  FROM cash_flow cf
  JOIN rebalance rb ON cf.investor_id = rb.investor_id
  JOIN sector sec ON cf.investor_id = sec.investor_id
  JOIN scenario sc ON cf.investor_id = sc.investor_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    net_cash_flow,
    total_rebalance_amount,
    total_sector_investment,
    total_scenario_allocation_shift,
    MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER () AS min_net_cash_flow,
    MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () AS max_net_cash_flow,
    MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS min_total_rebalance_amount,
    MAX(total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS max_total_rebalance_amount,
    MIN(total_sector_investment) OVER () AS min_total_sector_investment,
    MAX(total_sector_investment) OVER () AS max_total_sector_investment,

    MAX(total_scenario_allocation_shift) OVER () AS max_total_scenario_allocation_shift
  FROM combined
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    CASE WHEN max_net_cash_flow = min_net_cash_flow THEN 0.5 ELSE (net_cash_flow - min_net_cash_flow) / (max_net_cash_flow - min_net_cash_flow) END AS norm_net_cash_flow,
    CASE WHEN max_total_rebalance_amount = min_total_rebalance_amount THEN 0.5 ELSE (total_rebalance_amount - min_total_rebalance_amount) / (max_total_rebalance_amount - min_total_rebalance_amount) END AS norm_total_rebalance_amount,
    CASE WHEN max_total_sector_investment = min_total_sector_investment THEN 0.5 ELSE (total_sector_investment - min_total_sector_investment) / (max_total_sector_investment - min_total_sector_investment) END AS norm_total_sector_investment,
    CASE WHEN max_total_scenario_allocation_shift = min_total_scenario_allocation_shift THEN 0.5 ELSE (total_scenario_allocation_shift - min_total_scenario_allocation_shift) / (max_total_scenario_allocation_shift - min_total_scenario_allocation_shift) END AS norm_total_scenario_allocation_shift
  FROM stats
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    investor_id,
    100 * ( (norm_net_cash_flow + norm_total_rebalance_amount + norm_total_sector_investment + norm_total_scenario_allocation_shift) / 4.0 ) AS composite_score
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT investor_id, composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

combined AS (

        gl.avg_shortfall
    FROM cash_flow cf

    INNER JOIN scenario sc ON cf.investor_id = sc.investor_id
    INNER JOIN goal gl ON cf.investor_id = gl.investor_id

stats AS (

        MIN(avg_shortfall) AS min_shortfall,
        MAX(avg_shortfall) AS max_shortfall
    FROM combined
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        investor_id,
        net_cash_flow,
        total_rebalance_amount,
        total_scenario_shift,
        avg_shortfall,
        (net_cash_flow - min_ncf) / (max_ncf - min_ncf) AS norm_ncf,

WITH cash_flow AS (

sector AS (
  SELECT "investor_id", SUM("total_investment") AS "total_sector_investment"
  FROM "ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001"
  GROUP BY "investor_id"
),
scenario AS (
  SELECT "investor_id", SUM("new_allocation_pct" - "current_allocation_pct") AS "total_scenario_shift"
  FROM "ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001"
  GROUP BY "investor_id"
),
health AS (
  SELECT "investor_id", "risk_score"
  FROM "ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    c."investor_id",
    c."net_cash_flow",
    s."total_sector_investment",
    sc."total_scenario_shift",
    h."risk_score"
  FROM cash_flow c
  JOIN sector s ON c."investor_id" = s."investor_id"
  JOIN scenario sc ON c."investor_id" = sc."investor_id"
  JOIN health h ON c."investor_id" = h."investor_id"
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("net_cash_flow") AS "min_net_cash_flow",
    MAX("net_cash_flow") AS "max_net_cash_flow",
    MIN("total_sector_investment") AS "min_total_sector_investment",
    MAX("total_sector_investment") AS "max_total_sector_investment",
    MIN("total_scenario_shift") AS "min_total_scenario_shift",
    MAX("total_scenario_shift") AS "max_total_scenario_shift",
    MIN("risk_score") AS "min_risk_score",
    MAX("risk_score") AS "max_risk_score"
  FROM combined
),
normalized AS (
  SELECT
    "investor_id",
    CASE
      WHEN stats."max_net_cash_flow" = stats."min_net_cash_flow" THEN 0.0
      ELSE ("net_cash_flow" - stats."min_net_cash_flow") * 1.0 / (stats."max_net_cash_flow" - stats."min_net_cash_flow")
    END AS "norm_net_cash_flow",
    CASE
      WHEN stats."max_total_sector_investment" = stats."min_total_sector_investment" THEN 0.0
      ELSE ("total_sector_investment" - stats."min_total_sector_investment") * 1.0 / (stats."max_total_sector_investment" - stats."min_total_sector_investment")
    END AS "norm_total_sector_investment",
    CASE
      WHEN stats."max_total_scenario_shift" = stats."min_total_scenario_shift" THEN 0.0
      ELSE ("total_scenario_shift" - stats."min_total_scenario_shift") * 1.0 / (stats."max_total_scenario_shift" - stats."min_total_scenario_shift")
    END AS "norm_total_scenario_shift",
    CASE
      WHEN stats."max_risk_score" = stats."min_risk_score" THEN 0.0
      ELSE ("risk_score" - stats."min_risk_score") * 1.0 / (stats."max_risk_score" - stats."min_risk_score")
    END AS "norm_risk_score"
  FROM combined, stats
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    "investor_id",
    100.0 * ("norm_net_cash_flow" + "norm_total_sector_investment" + "norm_total_scenario_shift" + "norm_risk_score") / 4.0 AS "composite_score"
  FROM normalized
)
SELECT
  "investor_id",
  "composite_score"
FROM scored
ORDER BY "composite_score" DESC, "investor_id" ASC
LIMIT 10;
